compatibility.tower_authority_field: legacy field name retained for v1 consumers; value means Tower recommendation provenance, never project-direction authority

decision_semantics.KEEP: Tower recommends retaining the incumbent for the named responsibility and records why another runtime would not improve the boundary.
decision_semantics.ADD: Tower recommends a new technology for a new architectural responsibility while preserving the incumbent implementation unless the Operator separately directs replacement or evidence proves an accepted supersession path.
decision_semantics.SPLIT: Tower recommends moving a responsibility behind an explicit interface into another technology; functional and proof parity are required for overlapping semantics before the incumbent may be retired.
decision_semantics.EXPERIMENT: Tower recommends benchmarking or exercising a competing technology in a reversible path; the incumbent remains the technical baseline until evidence and Operator direction establish the next state.

diversity_objective: Maximize useful language and runtime diversity by assigning each technology a defensible responsibility, activation condition, interface, and proof burden; never add languages merely to increase the count.
